name: ChannelShapeClassification

chapter_title: Part II: Trend Lines and Channels (introduction)

name: DuelingLinesConfluence

name: SlopingChannelIsOppositeFlag

name: FailedBreakoutOfFallingChannelWithinNBars

name: AnchorSpikeExclusionForChannelLine

name: BullChannelConfirmedByTwoLegs

name: TightChannelSmallPullbacks
